about_the_game:
DIVE INTO THE HULL FROZEN IN TIME

Space Scavenger is a time-limited sci-fi exploration experience set aboard a derelict ship drifting through the void. As a contracted scavenger for Voidhaul, your mission is simple: retrieve the ship’s containment core intact, or don’t come back at all.

Navigate haunting, frozen corridors where every movement and decision matters. Plan your route carefully, use your limited tools wisely, and make your escape before the ship collapses around you.

REMEMBER, THE CORE ALWAYS COMES FIRST

Your only mission is to retrieve the core intact. Everything else is expendable. Voidhaul doesn’t pay for blown cargo or empty hands. Leave the ship without the core, and you have failed your contract.

CHOOSE YOUR APPROACH BEFORE THE HEAT

Use your scavenger toolkit of cutting, hacking, scanning, and grappling to chart your path or improvise on the fly. Once the core is disconnected, the clock starts ticking. Mark your escape route, keep your head cool, and make it out before the hull becomes your tomb.

KEY FEATURES

  • Time-Limited Space Experience: Explore the ships and plan your moves. Escape before the clock runs out.

  • Immersive Zero-Gravity Gameplay: Navigate derelict interiors with realistic momentum.

  • Scavenger’s Toolkit: Cut, hack, and grapple your way through debris and locked systems.

  • High-Stakes Extraction: Once the core is detached, survival becomes your only goal.

  • Atmospheric Worldbuilding: Experience Voidhaul’s cold corporate grip on deep-space salvage.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (3GB) / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended

short_description: Board a derelict ship frozen in time. Use your scavenger tools to cut, hack, and grapple through its corridors. Retrieve the containment core intact and make your escape before the ship—and you—are lost to the void.
